l-e-e6-b06-08.title: Ma'aunin rarraba jimloli masu auxiliary verbs
l-e-e6-b06-08.goal: Don raba jimloli uku masu auxiliary verb bisa yadda ake amfani da su, yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayani) ake bukata da gaske sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-e6-b06-08.material: Kana son raba jimlolin “Birds can fly. / May I come in? / It might rain.” zuwa rukuni masu amfani iri ɗaya.
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma'auni ne ya fi dacewa wajen rarrabawa?
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s1.r.a: Ba za ka iya gane ko amfaninsu iri ɗaya ne daga yawan kalmomi ba.
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s1.r.b: Ko subject mutum ne, ma'anar auxiliary verb tana bambanta.
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s1.o.c: Ko auxiliary verb yana bayyana iyawa, izini, ko yiwuwa
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s1.r.d: Dukkansu suna farawa da babban harafi, don haka ba za ka iya raba su ta wannan ba.
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s1.explain: Can yana nufin iyawa, may I yana nufin izini, might kuma yana nufin yiwuwa. Idan an raba su bisa ma'ana, jimlolin ukun sun bambanta.
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s2.model.0: Amfani ya bambanta bisa ko auxiliary verb yana bayyana iyawa, izini, ko yiwuwa, don haka a yi amfani da ma'ana a matsayin ma'auni.
l-e-e6-b06-08.s.s2.model.1: Yawan kalmomi da manyan haruffa iri ɗaya ne a jimlolin ukun, saboda haka ma'anar auxiliary verb ce ma'aunin da ya dace.

l-e-e6-b06-09.title: Rarraba kalmomin kafin da bayan
l-e-e6-b06-09.goal: Don rarraba “first, earlier / later, finally”, yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayani) ake bukata da gaske sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-e6-b06-09.material: Kana son raba first, earlier, later, da finally zuwa rukuni biyu: “kalmomin abin da ya faru da farko” da “kalmomin abin da ya faru daga baya”.
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.prompt: Wane zaɓi ne ya raba rukunan biyu daidai?
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.o.a: Kafin: first, finally / Bayan: earlier, later
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.r.a: Finally yana nufin abin da ya faru a ƙarshe.
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.o.b: Kafin: first, earlier / Bayan: later, finally
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.o.c: Kafin: later, first / Bayan: earlier, finally
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.r.c: Later na nufin bayan haka. Kada a saka shi cikin rukunin kafin.
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.o.d: Kafin: earlier, finally / Bayan: first, later
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.r.d: First yana nufin abin da ya fara faruwa.
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s1.explain: First da earlier suna nufin kafin, later da finally kuma suna nufin bayan. Don haka rarrabawar farko ce daidai.
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s2.model.0: First da earlier abubuwa ne da suka faru kafin, later da finally kuma suna nuna abin da ya faru daga baya, don haka haka ake raba su.
l-e-e6-b06-09.s.s2.model.1: Finally na nufin ƙarshe, first kuma farkon abu, saboda haka raba su zuwa kafin da bayan haka daidai ne.

l-e-e6-b06-13.goal: Dubi misalai da dama na sigar da ake amfani da ita wajen mayar da need to marar korewa, faɗi ƙa'idar da ka gano, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.

l-e-e6-b06-13.s.s1.r.c: An yi amfani da not kawai, ba tare da don't ba.
l-e-e6-b06-13.s.s1.r.d: An cire to. A misalan an bar to yadda yake.
l-e-e6-b06-13.s.s1.explain: Don mayar da need to marar korewa, saka don't a gabanta kuma a bar need to yadda yake.
l-e-e6-b06-13.s.s2.model.0: A misalan an saka don't kafin need to, saboda haka I don't need to wait. ta bi ƙa'idar.
l-e-e6-b06-13.s.s2.model.1: Dukkan misalan suna da tsarin don't + need to, don haka a rubuta shi da wannan tsarin.

l-e-e6-b06-15.goal: Dubi misalai da dama na ƙa'idar yawan kalmomin da ake haddacewa kowace rana, faɗi ƙa'idar da ka gano, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-e6-b06-15.material: Kana haddace kalmomi 2 a Rana 1, kalmomi 6 a Rana 2, da kalmomi 18 a Rana 3. Adadin kalmomin da ake haddacewa kowace rana yana ƙaruwa bisa tsari. Nemo ƙa'idar sannan ka gano Rana 4.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.prompt: Kalmomi nawa za ka haddace a Rana 4?
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: An ƙara 6 ga 18. Ba adadin da ake ƙarawa ba ne yake zama iri ɗaya, ninkin ne yake zama iri ɗaya.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: An ƙara 18 ga 18. 2→6→18 yana ninkuwa sau 3 a kowane lokaci.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.r.d: An ninka 18 da 9. Ninkin da ake yi shi ne 3.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s1.explain: 2 → 6 → 18 yana ninkuwa sau 3 a kowane lokaci. Don haka Rana 4 ita ce 18 × 3 = kalmomi 54.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Yana ninkuwa sau 3 a kowane lokaci, daga 2 zuwa 6 sannan daga 6 zuwa 18, don haka Rana 4 ita ce sau 3 na 18, wato kalmomi 54.
l-e-e6-b06-15.s.s2.model.1: Ƙa'idar ita ce a ninka adadin baya da 3, saboda haka 18 × 3 = 54, kuma kalmomi 54 daidai ne.

l-e-e6-b07-05.goal: Gano da bayyana ƙa'ida daga misalai da yawa na jimlar babba a gajeren rubutu, sannan gwada ƙa'idar da sabon misali.
l-e-e6-b07-05.material: Rubutu 1: Cats suna ɗan barci a rana. Cats suna ɗan barci a kan gadaje. Cats suna barci sosai. Rubutu 2: Bees suna aiki tuƙuru. Bees suna yin zuma. Bees suna ziyartar furanni. Jimlar babba ita ce ta ƙarshe a Rubutu 1, ta farko kuma a Rubutu 2. Gano ƙa'idar.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Rubutu 3: Lee yana iyo. Lee yana gudu. Lee yana hawan keke. Lee yana da kuzari sosai. Wace ce jimlar babba?

l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: Tana magana kan gudu kawai. Ba ta ƙunshi sauran ayyukan ba.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Tana magana kan hawan keke kawai. Ba ta ƙunshi sauran ayyukan ba.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s1.explain: Jimlar babba ba ta shafi wurinta ba, tana shafi haɗa sauran jimloli ne. “Lee yana da kuzari sosai.” tana haɗa ayyukan ukun.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: Jimlar babba a kowane rubutu tana ƙunshe da sauran jimloli; saboda haka a Rubutu 3 ita ce “Lee yana da kuzari sosai.”, wadda ta haɗa iyo, gudu, da hawan keke.
l-e-e6-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Jimlar babba na iya kasancewa a farko ko ƙarshe; abin da ya fi muhimmanci ba wurinta ba ne, abin da ta ƙunsa ne. Shi ya sa “kuzari sosai” shi ne jigon.
